# Tipse

> Tipse is a cashless tipping and guest feedback service in Georgia. Its public website is https://tipse.ge/ and its application is https://app.tipse.ge/.

Guests can scan an employee's QR code to open the tipping flow. They can choose a tip amount, rate the service, and leave feedback. Businesses can manage their teams and review guest feedback in the application.

The public landing page is available in English, Russian, and Georgian. Business onboarding starts with a Google Form; submitting it is a request to be contacted, not confirmation that an account has been activated. Existing users sign in through the application.

For fees and payment conditions, refer to the Terms of Service and the information displayed in the payment interface. This overview does not replace the legal documents. Contact: info@tipse.ge.

## Website

- [English landing page](https://tipse.ge/): How Tipse works, benefits for guests, businesses and staff, and QR code placement examples.
- [Russian landing page](https://tipse.ge/rus.html): Russian version of the public landing page.
- [Georgian landing page](https://tipse.ge/geo.html): Georgian version of the public landing page.

## Registration and application

- [Business registration request](https://forms.gle/3ADWyS74WoTugsmN7): Provide venue and contact information so the Tipse team can follow up.
- [Tipse application](https://app.tipse.ge/): Sign-in entry point for existing users.

- [Terms linked from the Georgian site](https://tipse.ge/Terms-of-Service-geo.html): The agreement body is currently in English.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tipse.ge/Privacy-Policy.html): Personal data processing policy.
- [Privacy Policy linked from the Russian site](https://tipse.ge/Privacy-Policy-rus.html): Privacy policy linked by the Russian landing page.
- [Privacy Policy linked from the Georgian site](https://tipse.ge/Privacy-Policy-geo.html): Privacy policy linked by the Georgian landing page.
